criterion: which COVID-19-related user intent the utterance expresses

categories.name: General COVID-19 Information
categories.definition: User seeks broad or foundational knowledge about COVID-19, its nature, origin, or general facts.

categories.name: Symptoms and Personal Health
categories.definition: User inquires about COVID-19 symptoms, how to identify them, or assesses their personal health risk.

categories.name: Transmission and Prevention
categories.definition: User asks about how COVID-19 spreads, methods of protection, or best practices to avoid infection for themselves, others, or pets.

categories.name: Treatment, Cure, and Vaccine
categories.definition: User seeks information about medical treatments, potential cures, or vaccine availability and development.

categories.name: Statistics and Updates
categories.definition: User requests current data, case numbers, death tolls, recovery rates, or general news updates related to COVID-19, often location-specific.

categories.name: Travel and Restrictions
categories.definition: User asks about the safety of travel, current travel bans, quarantine rules, or high-risk locations for travel.

categories.name: Myths and Misinformation
categories.definition: User seeks to verify, debunk, or identify false information and myths about COVID-19.

categories.name: Donation Intent
categories.definition: User expresses a desire or intent to contribute financially or materially to COVID-19 relief efforts.

categories.name: Information Sharing Intent
categories.definition: User expresses a desire to share the received information or the service itself with others.
